main.description: Append one beat of a uzu 渦 organism's dissipative loop to the kotoba Datom log (:uzu.beat/*). The ENERGY ledger (:uzu.beat/energy — conserved, depleting) and the INFORMATION free energy (:uzu.beat/free-energy — nats) are SEPARATE fields and must never be conflated into one quantity (G1). Synthetic/simulated organisms only at R0 (:uzu/sourcing :synthetic); there is NO per-person field (G9).

regime.description: the TRUE (hidden) world regime that beat

beliefOf.description: the regime the organism BELIEVED most likely

action.description: the action chosen by minimizing expected free energy

energy.description: :uzu.beat/energy — the CONSERVED metabolic balance after the beat (energy units, NOT nats)

freeEnergy.description: :uzu.beat/free-energy — variational free energy / surprise (INFORMATION, nats; NOT energy units)

gained.description: energy drawn from the TRUE regime this beat

spent.description: basal + inference + action + hazard cost this beat

alive.description: :uzu.beat/alive — false once the energy balance reaches zero (self-maintenance is earned, not assumed)

txCid.description: kotoba transaction CID (content-addressed append-only Datom log; ADR-2605312345)
